== Commanding ==
=== Command Bar ===
The command bar displays information about subordinate units. Each unit under your command shows: <br>
* ID: 1, 2, 3 ...<br>
* Rank ([[File:a3_fm_private.png|24px]] [[File:a3_fm_sergeant.png|24px]] [[File:a3_fm_corporal.png|24px]] [[File:a3_fm_major.png|24px]]...) <br>
* Specialization ([[File:a3_fm_aa.png|24px]] [[File:a3_fm_at.png|24px]] [[File:a3_fm_gl.png|24px]] [[File:a3_fm_mg.png|24px]] [[File:a3_fm_scuba.png|24px]] [[File:a3_fm_srifle.png|24px]])<br>
* Vehicle occupation<br>
* Vehicle role ([[File:a3_fm_imageDriver.png|24px]] [[File:a3_fm_imageCargo.png|24px]] [[File:a3_fm_imageCommander.png|24px]] [[File:a3_fm_imageGunner.png|24px]])<br>
* Health Condition: Wounded [[File:a3_fm_unitNameBackground_normal_wounded.png|24px]], No Ammo [[File:a3_fm_unitNameBackground_normal_noAmmo.png|24px]]<br>
* [[Combat_Modes | Combat mode]]: Hold Fire [[File:a3_fm_unitCombatMode_red.png|24px]]<br>
* Behavior: Stealth [[File:a3_fm_unitBehavior_stealth.png|24px]], Combat [[File:a3_fm_unitBehavior_combat.png|24px]]<br>
* Current orders: 'Move'


=== Complex Commands ===
Assign complex commands from the command menu.<br>
* Open the quick command menu '''[~]'''. This selects all your subordinate units.<br>
* Press '''[Backspace]''' to open complex commands.<br>
Alternatively access specific categories via predefined keys '''[0–9]:'''<br>
1 – Move<br>
2 – Target<br>
3 – Engage<br>
4 – Mount<br>
5 – Status<br>
6 – Action<br>
7 – Combat mode<br>
8 – Formation<br>
9 – Team<br>
0 – Reply<br>
* '''[Backspace]''' returns to the root menu for selected units or closes the menu.


=== Target Assignment ===
As a team leader, you can assign targets to your teammates: <br>
* Report a target for the whole team by pressing '''[T]'''.<br>
You can also assign targets individually: <br>
* Select a teammate '''[F2–F10]'''. <br>
* Point at the target. <br>
* Choose '''Attack'''.


=== Side Markers ===
Units are marked according to their side.<br>
[[File:a3_fm_b_unknown_blue.png|24px]] – BLUFOR (Blue)<br>
[[File:a3_fm_o_unknown_red.png|24px]] – OPFOR (Red)<br>
[[File:a3_fm_n_unknown_green.png|24px]] – Independent (Green Army, Green Guerillas)<br>
[[File:a3_fm_n_unknown_purple.png|24px]] – Neutral (Civilians)


=== Quick Commands ===
As a commander, you have access to quick commands via the quick command menu '''[~]'''. The menu is context sensitive – commands change according to objects you point at. Select some units with '''[F2-F10]''' and:<br>
* Use '''[Space]''' on a position to issue a move command.<br>
* Use '''[Space]''' on a target to issue an engage command.<br>
* Use '''[Space]''' on a vehicle to order mount.<br>
* To change the direction your units are facing, Use '''[Space]''' while holding '''[Left Alt]''' when pointing at a position.

''When you open quick commands, the whole squad is selected by default.''


=== Command Responses ===
As a subordinate unit in need of a quick response, press '''[~]''' to open the quick command menu. Here you can select one of the responses to your incoming commands:<br>
* Done<br>
* Negative<br>
* Ready to fire<br>
* Cannot fire<br>
* Repeat<br>
* Copy<br>
* One less<br>
* Where are you?<br>
* Support<br>
* Custom – used for more complex conversations such as support requests<br>
* Radio


=== Selecting ===
* Select your subordinates with '''[F2–F10] keys'''.<br>
* Use '''[F11]''' and '''[F12]''' to scroll between command bar filled with more than 10 units.<br>
* Select all subordinates with '''[~]'''.


=== Teams ===
Units can be organized into teams for a quick selection. This is useful when commanding a large number of units.<br>
* Select units.<br>
* Choose Assign '''[9]'''.<br>
* Choose a team color from the menu.<br>
Alternatively:<br>
* Select units.<br>
* Press '''[Left Ctrl] + [F1-F5]''' to create a team.<br>
To select the entire team:<br>
* Use '''[Left Shift] + [F1-F5]'''.

''White team is used for any unassigned units.''


=== Move! ===
When in command, you can issue move orders to your subordinates. <br>
To issue a single waypoint without entering the map:<br>
* Select units with '''[F2–F10] keys'''.<br>
* Select '''Move there'''.<br>
* Confirm with '''[Space]'''.<br>
Issue a waypoint [[File:a3_fm_waypoint.png|24px]] using the map: <br>
* Open the map '''[M]'''.  <br>
* Select units with '''[F2–F10] keys'''.<br>
* Select '''Move there'''.<br>
* Confirm with '''[Space]'''.

''The '''Move there''' order is only available when a unit can reach the place.''


=== Formations ===
As you move, you can see that your subordinates are following you in a certain formation. Try changing the default '''Wedge''' formation to '''Line''' or '''Column'''.<br>
* Select all your units with '''[Left Ctrl+~]'''.<br>
* Press '''[8]''' and choose '''new formation'''.


=== Vehicles ===
Order your men to get in a certain vehicle:<br>
* Select your units with '''[F2-F10]'''.<br>
* Press '''[4]''' to bring up the list of nearby vehicles.<br>
* Select a vehicle from the list.<br>
According to the vehicle type, you have the option to choose between specific positions like driver, gunner or commander.


=== Stances ===
You can adjust the direction your units are facing.<br>
* Select the desired unit with '''[F2-F10]'''.<br>
* Press '''[3]''', '''[8]''' and choose the azimuth.<br>
As standing units are easily seen and hit, you can order your men to kneel or go prone.<br>
* Select your units with '''[F2-F10]'''.<br>
* Press '''[7]''' and choose the appropriate position.<br>
* To watch for incoming enemy units on the horizon, press '''[3]''', '''[7]''' to '''Scan horizon'''.


=== Team Inventory ===
When you're a team leader, you can access your teammate's inventories via the Journal.  <br>
* Open the Map '''[M]'''. <br>
* Click '''Units'''. <br>
* Select a soldier with '''[F2–F10] keys'''. <br>
* Click '''Inventory'''.
